messages:
maria: Quick plan for post-webinar social + inbound routing. We want: 1) X thread recap (clip + TL;DR), 2) LinkedIn article repurpose, 3) short clips for community channels, 4) lead routing rules for SDRs. Can we scope and owner by EOD?
linda: I can do the X thread + clips. Suggest 3 tweets: announce recording, highlight stat, CTA to trial/demo. Will need 3 clips: 15s highlight, 30s snippet, GIF.
josh: Ill draft the LinkedIn article repurposing the webinar key takeaways + benchmark table. Also can provide 3 pull quotes for social.
priya: For tracking: utm_source={x|linkedin|community}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=serving_post_webinar_v1, utm_content={clip|recap|article}. I'll create HubSpot workflow: if utm_campaign=serving_post_webinar_v1 AND utm_content=clip -> tag 'clip_engaged'.
sam (SDR): Routing: create HubSpot view = webinar_post_webinar_inbound. Rules: immediate assignment if company_size>100 or title contains PM/Eng/Infra; otherwise queue to SDR - Growth for 48h nurture. Add a task for 'watch recording' if lead came from community.
kevin: Also want a rapid-response for comments on X: if someone asks product question, route to sales-inbound Slack with transcript and lead record. Priya, can you add that trigger?
priya: Yep  I'll add Zap: new comment on post -> create HubSpot activity + Slack message to #sales-inbound with link and verbatim. Add priority tag if contains keywords (latency, cost, regulatory).
inda: Copy ideas for X thread (draft):
- Tweet 1: "Missed our Serving Inference webinar? Recording + TL;DR -> [link]?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_post_webinar_v1&utm_content=recap"
- Tweet 2: "Key stat: prefix caching + batching cut per-token cost ~40% on production traces. See how -> [link]"
- Tweet 3: "Want help applying this to your stack? Book a quick consult -> calendly link. #mlops"
josh: LinkedIn article opener draft: "Serving LLMs economically is repeatable work. In our webinar we ran three experiments and found practical levers you can apply today. Below are the top takeaways and how to prioritize them." Will add bullet takeaways and embed the clip.
maria: Good. Community plan: post 15s clip in Discord + Hacker News copy (short summary + link). Community-bot, can you schedule Discord post and monitor replies?
community-bot: Scheduled Discord post for channel #product-discussions at 11:00 PST tomorrow. Monitoring enabled for 72h; will forward replies with >3 upvotes to #marketing.
priya: Also propose a paid retarget for registrants who didn't book a demo: utm_paid=1 and audience=registrants_no_demo_7d. Kevin please confirm budget.
kevin: I'll provision a $1k test budget for the retarget cohort. Target: enterprise infra job titles.
sam (SDR): Outreach templates for post-webinar leads:
- Auto-email (recording): "Thanks for joining! Recording + key snippets. If you'd like a quick call to discuss your infra telemetry, book here."
- High-intent: "Saw you engaged with the clip about batching. We can run a quick cost calc for your traces  want 20 min?"
- Community responder: "Thanks for the comment in Discord. Would love to learn more about your stack. Can we book 15 min?"
maria: Timeline: linda schedule posts Tue 11am, josh publish LinkedIn article Tue 12pm, priya wire HubSpot/UTM by Tue 10am, sam confirm templates by Tue 10:30, kevin confirm paid budget by Tue 9am. Buffer-bot will hold drafts until approvals.
buffer-bot: Drafts created and held: X thread, LinkedIn post, community clips. Approval needed by Tue 9:30 PST.
maria: One more thing  please attach a 1-line summary to each HubSpot lead record for SDRs (e.g., "Came from clip about batching -> interested in cost/latency tradeoffs"). Priya can you add that field?
priya: Will add property `social_lead_summary` and populate via Zap parsing clip content or utm_content.
linda: I'll A/B test two thumbnails for the clip: stat-first vs people-first. Will report back CTRs in 48h.
maria: Thanks all  once Buffer drafts are up tag me and I'll approve.
